description.value:
The interiors of your wrists are replaced with miniature cloches that germinate magically enhanced tangle vine seeds under the perfect conditions, ready to grow in an instant in response to magical stimulus.

Activate—Vinesnare 2 You release one of the seeds stored in your wrists, growing a whiplike vine in an instant. Attempt an unarmed Strike with the effects of a 1st-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Tangle Vine] cantrip. You can also target a surface instead of a creature; if you do, the vine roots itself into the surface, acting as a 30-foot rope securely attached to that surface until you cut the vine. You can't use Vinesnare again for 1 minute after using it to target a surface.
